releases.description: Hardware target migrated to the QMTECH Wukong Artix-7 (XC7A100T); legacy board support retired from the IDE.
releases.notes: Download the Verilog netlist and build with Vivado (source wukong_xc7a100t.tcl). The bitstream lands at church_wukong_xc7a100t.bit; a pre-built .bit is available from the Connect tab.

releases.description: Boot ROM corrected — LOAD AL,CR15,CR15[0] → CHANGE AL,CR12,CR15,#1 → CALL AL,CR0 (cr_src=15 on CHANGE, was 12). Builder ZIP downloads fixed for all 3 boards.
releases.notes: Download the Verilog source and synthesise with Efinity 2024.1 or later. The .bit file lands in outflow/church_ti60_f225.bit.
